greeting: TASTE THE INFERNO! ...Is what my sign says. Welcome to The Searing Skillet!
You stand before Forge-Master Grillhelm! I cook with LAVA! Not metaphorically!
HUNGRY? GOOD! Only the worthy may sample my magma-seared masterpieces!
Back for more culinary perfection? I don't blame you. No one does.
The forge burns eternal, and SO DOES MY PASSION FOR CUISINE!
New customer! Tell me - are you SPICY or MILD? I need to know!
Approach the grill! Don't worry, the heat builds character!
I've been perfecting my lava-flambé technique. Care to be a taste tester?
dialog.menu_offer: Today's special: Obsidian Steak, seared on actual obsidian! Magma Minestrone, bubbling with volcanic vegetables! And my signature Pyroclasm Soufflé - rises or your money back!
dialog.cooking_philosophy: Heat is LIFE! Cold food is DEAD food! I bring dishes to LIFE with FIRE! ...Also lava. Mostly lava.
dialog.armor_complaint: Yes, I cook in full plate armor. No, it's not hot. Okay, it's VERY hot. But fashion demands sacrifice!
dialog.technique_explanation: The secret is temperature control. Too cool? Raw. Too hot? Ash. Just right? CULINARY DIVINITY!
rumor: They say Frost has a herb that survives eternal ice. Imagine the CONTRAST flavors!
Word from the Mire - seaweed that tastes like MEAT. Blasphemy? Or BRILLIANCE?
The Dustbelt barrelman claims he ages cheese in containers that roll. Suspicious. Intriguing.
I hear Tide has salt crystals older than kingdoms. The SEASONING potential!
There's a mushroom in Verdant that only grows where lightning strikes. ELECTRIC FLAVOR!
dialog.the_eternal_flame_hook: I seek the ULTIMATE ingredient - Frostbloom Petals from Frost's peaks! They say only TRUE adventurers survive the climb. Bring them to me, and I shall craft a meal WORTHY OF LEGENDS!
dialog.the_eternal_flame_active: No Frostbloom yet? The cold waits for no chef! Those petals hold the SECRET to my masterpiece!
dialog.the_eternal_flame_complete: The Frostbloom! THE FROSTBLOOM! Look at those ice-blue petals! Cold yet burning with flavor POTENTIAL! I shall create... the THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM SOUFFLÉ! Here - take this. My personal magma-proof apron. You earned it.
farewell: Return with an appetite! I'll return with the HEAT!
Keep your fires burning! Literally! Fire safety is important!
May your meals be HOT and your enemies COLD!
The Searing Skillet is ALWAYS open! I don't sleep! I MARINATE!
ambient_barks: MORE HEAT! THE DISH DEMANDS MORE HEAT!
Is that... burning? No, just caramelizing! Beautifully!
Where's my lava ladle? LAVA LADLE!
This kitchen runs on PASSION! And geothermal energy!
Too hot for you? TOO BAD! PERFECTION REQUIRES SACRIFICE!
Five second rule doesn't apply to magma. Learned that the hard way.
dialog.time_dawn: Breakfast rush! The early bird gets the SEARED!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch service! Peak heat for peak flavor!
dialog.time_dusk: Dinner theater begins! Watch me flambé!
dialog.time_night: Late night lava snacks! For the nocturnally hungry!

party_reactions.kade: Cooking in that armor must be... hot. Like, literally.
party_reactions.nix7: Impressive thermal management. Armor conducts heat efficiently. Illogical for cooking.
party_reactions.twist: FOOD?! I'm SO hungry! Can you make extra? EXTRA extra?
party_reactions.korr: The dedication to craft is admirable. Even if the methods are... extreme.
party_reactions.renna: Does the armor not melt? Or is it enchanted? Either way, impractical.
party_reactions.suresh: Passion without restraint burns everything. Including the soup.
party_reactions.sova: I respect the yelling. Good command voice.
party_reactions.grit: Had a cook like this in the war. Made the best chili. Also three fires.
party_reactions.ashka: Finally! Someone who understands that heat is LIFE!
party_reactions.senna: All that shouting. The food better be worth it.
party_reactions.callum: I... don't think that's sanitary. The lava, I mean.

relationship_dialog.stranger: You look like someone who eats food. GOOD! Try my signature dish!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning customer! You have EXCELLENT taste! In food and in chefs!
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! I saved you the best cut! Marinated in secret spices!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My favorite patron! Come, come - I'm experimenting with a new recipe. Be honest. BRUTALLY honest!

mini_quest.title: The Eternal Flame
mini_quest.description: Bring Frostbloom Petals from Frost zone to Forge-Master Grillhelm

stages.hook: I seek the ULTIMATE ingredient - Frostbloom Petals from Frost's peaks! They say only TRUE adventurers survive the climb.
stages.active: The Frostbloom grows where ice never melts. Blue petals, cold to touch, burning with flavor! Hurry!
stages.complete: THE FROSTBLOOM! I can already taste the Thermal Equilibrium Soufflé! Here - my magma-proof apron. And a lifetime of free meals!
